title: Byte addition in GF(2^8) is bitwise XOR
summary: When representing bytes as binary polynomial coefficients, addition and subtraction are both XORs, with no integer carry.
applies: Finite field polynomials and sampling with errors
detail: For example, 0x80+0x80 gets field element 0. The multiplication method also requires agreed irreducible polynomials.
boundary: This is different from the integer ring Z/256Z, where addition carries as an integer and has non-zero zero factors.
relevance: Distinguish between the two semantics of the question: "Bytes are used as field elements" and "The lower eight bits are retained after integer operations".
